scope: Additional sourced observances beyond the original 40 topic pages; supports the important-days hub, year pages and evergreen month pages. Does not edit or automatically extend the final route manifest.
coverage_statement: A curated, extensible expansion of relevant Slovenian, European, international and religious observances. This is not an exhaustive list of every local custom, festival, religious community or international campaign.
metrics_note: Editorial usefulness only; no keyword volume, traffic or ranking claim.

legal_status_method.status_basis: None of these additional observances itself grants a statutory work-free day in the verified holiday inventory. Government-declared commemorative day is not necessarily an Article 1 statutory holiday.
legal_status_method.important: Compute date-level work_free by OR across every coincident legal holiday; never let a nonstatutory observance reset that date to a working day. Halloween coincides with work-free Dan reformacije on 31 October.

generation_rules: Use civil dates, never UTC-midnight timestamps for these all-day calendar records.
Fixed recurring observance dates can be computed for 2027–2030; future festival programmes, themes, ticket prices, venues and opening hours cannot be inferred.
Keep multiple observances on the same date; 3 December has both Ta veseli dan kulture and Mednarodni dan invalidov.
Teden otroka is a seven-day period; for ICS use the exclusive end date.
A source news publication date can differ from the observance date; examples include the 23 August remembrance announcement and 2 October Animal Day article.
Revalidate rules and legal classification when implementing and during future source refreshes.
